is: The price table, the Claude Code transcript parser, the SQLite ledger that keeps what every run cost, the per-epic rows of `zaf report --epics` and the golden-file fixtures behind `zaf report`, which ports tools/burn.py.
conventions: Rendered text must reproduce burn.py's output exactly, checked against fixtures/*.expected.txt

fs.name: epics.rs
fs.role: `zaf report --epics`: one row per epic from the ledger, what it cost beside what it finished, and its planned count with its minutes of work, on questions and per planned task (or `-` and the reason it is left out)

fs.name: fixtures/
fs.role: Claude projects tree plus burn.py golden outputs

fs.name: ledger.rs
fs.role: the ledger: one row per run in an SQLite file on the machine, so the numbers outlive the transcripts

fs.name: times.rs
fs.role: an epic's times: gathered from the phase run folders and the board (`epic_times`, or left out with its reason), then its minutes of work and on questions, question intervals clipped to the window and united

fs.name: transcript.rs
fs.role: one *.jsonl to one Run, turns deduped by message id

notes: tools/burn.py is not tracked in this repo (retired 2026-10-28, in git history); the golden files are its output for `--root fixtures/projects --hours 100000`, run once
fixtures/projects/-demo mirrors a Claude config dir's projects/ layout, including a session's subagents/ folder
burn.match-plan.expected.txt is the output filtered to runs matching `Plan`
Dollar figures weigh runs against the weekly limit; compare shares, not decimals
